subject: The 3-text SMS flow getting 40%+ reply rates
html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Most fitness studios text a lead once, get no reply, and move on. That's leaving a lot of bookings on the table.


Here's the 3-message SMS flow that's getting 40%+ reply rates for studios right now:


Message 1 (Day 1): A short personal intro — reference how you found them and ask one specific question about their current client flow. No pitch.


Message 2 (Day 3): Follow up with a quick result relevant to their niche — something like “We helped a training studio book 22 consults last month with a 3-step AI workflow.” Two sentences max.


Message 3 (Day 7): A soft CTA — offer something specific like a custom AI plan for {{business_name}}, not a generic “hop on a call.”


The key is that each message builds on the last and feels personal, even though the whole flow is automated. Most replies come on message 2 or 3 — not message 1.


Want me to put together a custom AI + marketing plan for {{business_name}}? Book a quick discovery call — https://link.digigrowthllc.com/widget/booking/tydZBa2ehjdSRZopOMrn


Talk soon,
Dylan | Digigrowth
